name: AI Import Products from Google Sheets for WooCommerce
author: Dits.Agency

sections.description:
Stop wasting time on manual product updates. AI Import Products from Google Sheets for WooCommerce helps you import WooCommerce products from Google Sheets or CSV with flexible field mapping, safe batch processing, optional image sync, and AI-powered content generation.

Key Features

  • Import products from Google Sheets or CSV (mapping: SKU, title, description, price, status, etc.)
  • Batch processing for large catalogs (safer for servers)
  • Optional images sync (Google Drive folder column)
  • Optional AI content assistant (OpenAI): generate Title / Short / Full using your prompts
  • Works with multilingual WordPress installs (UI can be translated)

AI Content Assistant (Optional)

To generate product content you need your own OpenAI API key (paid service). You fully control prompts and the target language inside prompts.

Free vs PRO

The free version is perfect to start. PRO adds advanced automation (multiple sheets + scheduled imports).

Free
* 1 sheet per website
* Manual update (Run now)

PRO
* Unlimited sheets
* Scheduled imports (daily / weekly / monthly)

Privacy / External Services

This plugin can connect to external services:

1) Google APIs (Google Sheets / Google Drive)
Used to read spreadsheet data for import and (optionally) to fetch images from a Google Drive folder.
This happens only when an administrator connects Google and starts an import / image sync.

2) OpenAI API (Optional)
If enabled, the plugin sends your prompt and selected product fields to OpenAI to generate content.
You must provide your own OpenAI API key.

This plugin does not collect telemetry and does not send any data to the developer’s servers.

Service privacy policies:
– Google: https://policies.google.com/privacy
– OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  3. Open the plugin settings and configure:
    • Google integration (if you use Google Sheets / Drive)
    • OpenAI API key (only if you want AI content generation)
  4. Go to Import settings and add an import configuration row.
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for OpenAI?

Yes. OpenAI API is a commercial service. You need your own API key with a positive balance.

Which languages are supported for AI generation?

Any language. The output language is controlled by your prompt settings.

Can I update only prices and stock without changing descriptions?

Yes. After first import, updates can be limited to price/stock/status. Content is regenerated only when status-based rules require it (for example, switching to “Sale”).

How many products can I import?

There are no hard limits. The plugin processes data in batches to avoid server overload.
